title: Fix outdated pnpm-lock.yaml after @tanstack/react-virtual removal
body:
The lockfile referenced `@tanstack/react-virtual@^3.11.3` which was previously removed from `packages/plugin-aggrid/package.json`, causing CI to fail with `ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE`.

## Changes
- Regenerated `pnpm-lock.yaml` to remove stale dependency reference
